title: Cannon Car Wash - Low VRAM
author: Eric Rolph
tag_line: The full Cannon Car Wash experience, tuned for 2 GB graphics cards
description: The complete Cannon Car Wash - animated brushes, the midpoint vehicle restore, the layered dryer, the interactive control panel, and the fully contained 3-2-1-GO launch at 360 km/h - rebuilt for older graphics cards with 2 GB of VRAM such as the GTX 1050. All particle effects are removed (the biggest frame-rate cost on low-end GPUs), texture memory is cut to roughly a quarter, the dynamic light count drops from 13 to 5 brighter fixtures, and the brush fans carry fewer overdraw-heavy strand cards. Physics, collision, animations, and every gameplay feature are identical to the flagship mod. Install this edition OR the flagship - both can be installed side by side, but you only need one.
update_summary: Initial release of the Low VRAM edition, derived from Cannon Car Wash v1.48.3: no particle emitters, mip-stripped textures (max 1024 atlases / 512 tileables), 5 boosted lights instead of 13, and reduced brush-card overdraw. Identical physics and features.
